```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, results = "hide")

input_file <- knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE)
has_input_file <- !is.null(input_file) &&
  length(input_file) > 0 &&
  !is.na(input_file) &&
  nzchar(input_file)

if (has_input_file) {
  input_dir <- dirname(normalizePath(input_file, mustWork = FALSE))
  project_dir <- if (basename(input_dir) == "code") {
    normalizePath(file.path(input_dir, ".."), mustWork = TRUE)
  } else {
    normalizePath(input_dir, mustWork = TRUE)
  }
} else {
  cwd <- normalizePath(getwd(), mustWork = TRUE)
  project_dir <- if (basename(cwd) == "code") {
    normalizePath(file.path(cwd, ".."), mustWork = TRUE)
  } else {
    cwd
  }
}

knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = project_dir)
setwd(project_dir)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tximport)
  library(DESeq2)
  library(WGCNA)
  library(tidyverse)
  library(clusterProfiler)
  library(pheatmap)
  library(Mfuzz)
  library(Biobase)
  library(scales)
  library(igraph)
  library(ggrepel)
  library(jsonlite)
})


options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
WGCNA::allowWGCNAThreads()

rdata_dir <- file.path(project_dir, "RData")
dir.create(rdata_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

rds_file <- function(name) {
  file.path(rdata_dir, paste0(name, ".rds"))
}

cache_or_run <- function(name, expr, refresh = FALSE) {
  path <- rds_file(name)
  if (file.exists(path) && !refresh) {
    message("Loading cached object: ", path)
    readRDS(path)
  } else {
    message("Running and saving object: ", path)
    value <- force(expr)
    saveRDS(value, path)
    value
  }
}

load_rds_object <- function(name, required = TRUE) {
  path <- rds_file(name)
  if (!file.exists(path)) {
    if (required) stop("Missing cached object: ", path)
    return(NULL)
  }
  readRDS(path)
}

load_rds_list <- function(name, required = TRUE, envir = .GlobalEnv) {
  value <- load_rds_object(name, required = required)
  if (!is.null(value)) list2env(value, envir = envir)
  invisible(value)
}

analysis_file <- function(...) {
  file.path(rdata_dir, ...)
}

input_file_path <- function(...) {
  cached <- file.path(rdata_dir, ...)
  if (file.exists(cached)) return(cached)
  file.path(project_dir, ...)
}

show_table <- function(x, n = 20, title = NULL) {
  if (!is.null(title)) {
    cat("\n### ", title, "\n\n", sep = "")
  }
  if (is.null(x)) {
    cat("No object available.\n")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  df <- as.data.frame(x)
  if (nrow(df) == 0) {
    cat("No rows.\n")
    return(invisible(df))
  }
  print(utils::head(df, n))
  invisible(df)
}

show_plot_files <- function(paths) {
  paths <- paths[file.exists(paths)]
  if (length(paths) == 0) {
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  paths <- normalizePath(paths, mustWork = TRUE)
  knitr::include_graphics(paths)
}
```

```{r}
############################################################
## Rebuild Pt_TF_annotation.tsv from iTAK output
## Important: iTAK file has NO header
############################################################

library(tidyverse)

itak_file <- "tf_classification.txt"

clean_gene_id <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  id <- stringr::str_extract(x, "Pt[0-9]+G[0-9]+")
  ifelse(is.na(id), x, id)
}

normalize_tf_family <- function(x) {
  x0 <- toupper(str_trim(as.character(x)))
  
  case_when(
    str_detect(x0, "AP2|EREBP|ERF|DREB") ~ "AP2/ERF",
    str_detect(x0, "WRKY") ~ "WRKY",
    str_detect(x0, "NAC") ~ "NAC",
    str_detect(x0, "BZIP|TGA|ABI5") ~ "bZIP",
    str_detect(x0, "BHLH|MYC") ~ "bHLH",
    str_detect(x0, "MYB") ~ "MYB",
    str_detect(x0, "TCP") ~ "TCP",
    str_detect(x0, "MADS|AGL|SEP|SOC|VRN") ~ "MADS",
    str_detect(x0, "C2H2|ZAT") ~ "C2H2",
    str_detect(x0, "HD-ZIP|HDZIP|HOMEOBOX|HB") ~ "HD-ZIP",
    str_detect(x0, "C2C2DOF|DOF") ~ "DOF",
    str_detect(x0, "C2C2GATA|GATA") ~ "GATA",
    str_detect(x0, "GRAS") ~ "GRAS",
    str_detect(x0, "B3|ABI3|VP1") ~ "B3",
    str_detect(x0, "HSF") ~ "HSF",
    str_detect(x0, "ARF") ~ "ARF",
    str_detect(x0, "AUX|IAA") ~ "AUX/IAA",
    str_detect(x0, "G2LIKE|G2-LIKE") ~ "G2-like",
    str_detect(x0, "BES1") ~ "BES1",
    str_detect(x0, "BBR|BPC") ~ "BPC",
    str_detect(x0, "E2F|DP") ~ "E2F/DP",
    str_detect(x0, "CAMTA") ~ "CAMTA",
    str_detect(x0, "GRF") ~ "GRF",
    TRUE ~ as.character(x)
  )
}

tf_raw <- read_tsv(
  itak_file,
  col_names = FALSE,
  comment = "#",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

if (ncol(tf_raw) < 2) {
  tf_raw <- read_table(
    itak_file,
    col_names = FALSE,
    comment = "#",
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )
}

colnames(tf_raw)[1:4] <- c("Gene", "TF_family_raw", "Category", "Detail")

Pt_TF_annotation <- tf_raw %>%
  transmute(
    Gene = clean_gene_id(Gene),
    TF_family_raw = as.character(TF_family_raw),
    TF_family = normalize_tf_family(TF_family_raw),
    TF_name = Gene,
    Category = as.character(Category),
    Detail = as.character(Detail)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Gene), Gene != "",
    !is.na(TF_family), TF_family != ""
  ) %>%
  distinct(Gene, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  arrange(TF_family, Gene)

write_tsv(Pt_TF_annotation, analysis_file("Pt_TF_annotation.tsv"))

cat("Total TF genes:", nrow(Pt_TF_annotation), "\n")

Pt_TF_annotation %>%
  count(TF_family, name = "TF_count") %>%
  arrange(desc(TF_count)) %>%
  print(n = 50)
```
```{r}
library(tidyverse)

Pt_TF_annotation <- read_tsv(
  analysis_file("Pt_TF_annotation.tsv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

blast <- read_tsv(
  "Pt_TF_vs_Arabidopsis.blastp.tsv",
  col_names = c(
    "Gene", "Arabidopsis_hit",
    "pident", "length", "mismatch", "gapopen",
    "qstart", "qend", "sstart", "send",
    "evalue", "bitscore"
  ),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(
    Gene = Gene %>%
      as.character() %>%
      str_trim() %>%
      str_replace("\\s.*$", "") %>%
      str_replace("\\.\\d+$", ""),
    
    Arabidopsis_homolog = str_extract(Arabidopsis_hit, "AT[1-5CM]G[0-9]+")
  ) %>%
  arrange(Gene, evalue, desc(bitscore), desc(pident)) %>%
  group_by(Gene) %>%
  slice_head(n = 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(
    Gene,
    Arabidopsis_homolog,
    Arabidopsis_hit,
    Ath_pident = pident,
    Ath_evalue = evalue,
    Ath_bitscore = bitscore
  )

Pt_TF_annotation_with_Ath <- Pt_TF_annotation %>%
  left_join(blast, by = "Gene")

write_tsv(
  Pt_TF_annotation_with_Ath,
  analysis_file("Pt_TF_annotation.tsv")
)

Pt_TF_annotation_with_Ath %>%
  summarise(
    Total_TF = n(),
    With_Arabidopsis_homolog = sum(!is.na(Arabidopsis_homolog))
  )
```

```{r display-key-results, results='markup', echo=FALSE}
show_table(
  Pt_TF_annotation_with_Ath %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      Total_TF = dplyr::n(),
      With_Arabidopsis_homolog = sum(!is.na(Arabidopsis_homolog))
    ),
  n = 20,
  title = "TF annotation summary"
)
show_table(
  Pt_TF_annotation_with_Ath %>%
    dplyr::count(TF_family, name = "TF_count") %>%
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(TF_count)),
  n = 30,
  title = "TF family counts"
)
show_table(Pt_TF_annotation_with_Ath, n = 20, title = "TF annotation preview")
```
